correctness.rationale: PASS: Under independent Bernoulli rows, Lucas parity yields at most c^{2^{popcount(S_j)}} conditional coefficient means. Sparse binary-weight indices have exp(O((log log N)^2)) cardinality; binomial maximal atoms give the displayed annealed O(N^{-1/2+o(1)}) upper bound. Replacing one entire time row changes conditional F_N=E^beta Q_N^2 by at most 4/N, so McDiarmid and Borel-Cantelli give the almost-sure environment bound O_{beta,delta}(N^{-1/2+delta}); the normalized martingale predictable cross-bracket vanishes uniformly in probability and bounded jumps give planar quenched Brownian FCLT. All quantifiers require independent time-and-cardinality rows, epsilon ellipticity and fair independent driving signs. A separate finite exact enumeration recovered E_beta F_N=1/N for fair rows for N=1..4; it cannot certify the infinite limit.
